newsitem.title: POLAND: MC Securities says Agros long-term play.
newsitem.headline: MC Securities says Agros long-term play.

text.p: MC Securities Limited in London sees Polish food trader and producer Agros SA lifting consolidated net profit this year and remains bullish on the firm in the long term, MC Securities said in a report.

In a report dated February 21 MC Securities said Agros would lift consolidated net profit by 26 percent in nominal terms this year to 61.7 million zlotys, which represented real growth of seven percent.
It said consolidated net profit would grow by 41 percent in nominal terms to 86.8 million zlotys in 1998, a real increase of 12 percent year-on-year.

"With future prospects bright, and the injection of cash from the forthcoming issue allowing the company to expand its successful manufacturing operations, we continue to recommend Agros as a long-term play on the rapidly expanding consumer goods market in Poland," the report said.
In late March the company is offering 2.43 million shares at between 65 and 80 zlotys each.

MC Securities said Agros, which it said was dynamically managed and operating across rapidly growing branches of the food industry, would lift consolidated sales to 1.56 billion zlotys this year, also representing nominal growth of 26 percent and real growth of seven percent.
It saw consolidated sales rising to 1.98 billion zlotys in 1998, representing nominal growth of 27 percent and real growth of 10 percent.
"The company's recent emphasis on food processing has clearly started to benefit Agros Holding in terms of real revenue growth and enhanced bottom line performance," MC Securities said.
